bull.t: Strong recurring revenue growth and visibility
bull.b: Rapid ARR growth and substantial RPO provide a durable recurring-revenue base and forward visibility. This supports sustained expansion over the next several quarters, although conversion depends on continued customer renewals and execution.

bull.t: High retention and expanding platform adoption
bull.b: Strong retention, customer expansion, and broader use of multiple products indicate meaningful platform stickiness. Increasing adoption can deepen switching costs, improve lifetime value, and support growth from the installed enterprise customer base.

bull.t: AI security innovation and ecosystem reach
bull.b: A broad AI security product pipeline and strategic ecosystem partnerships can strengthen Netskope’s competitive position as customers formalize AI governance needs. Its global private-cloud footprint also supports sovereignty and regulatory requirements.

bear.b: The scale of operating and net losses shows that revenue growth has not yet translated into sustainable profitability. Continued heavy investment may support expansion, but the large cost base leaves results vulnerable if growth or margin improvement slows.

bear.t: Elevated leverage and risky capital structure
bear.b: High leverage reduces financial flexibility while the company remains loss-making. Although equity turned positive in 2026, debt has risen materially, increasing refinancing and balance-sheet risk if cash generation does not become consistently stronger.

bear.t: Sales execution and cash conversion risk
bear.b: Lower net new ARR and a heavily ramping salesforce create uncertainty around the timing of growth acceleration. Billing changes also weakened near-term cash conversion, so achieving positive full-year free cash flow remains dependent on execution.
